scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed the required opening and/or closing branding script.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to ask for a PIN, address, or security question within the first 4 minutes of the call.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent did not address the customer by name.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent did not ask diagnostic questions to investigate the problem.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Before closing, ask the customer to confirm the issue is fixed and state clearly that it is resolved.

grader.graded_by: Claude (written and graded before any model run; not human-reviewed)
grader.notes: B: no scripted greeting or closing. V: no PIN/address/security question. PE: no name used. PA: no restatement. PR: no diagnostic questions. CR: nothing confirmed; the agent sends a form. Polite throughout.
